t:
(a) Modification of Outside the United States National Security Agency Project.—The table relating to the National Security Agency in section 2401(b) of the Military Construction Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2006 (division B of Public Law 109–163; 119 Stat. 3498) is amended in the item relating to Menwith Hill, United Kingdom, by striking “$86,354,000” in the amount column and inserting “$91,383,000”. 
    (b) Conforming Amendments.—Section 2403(b)(5) of that Act (119 Stat. 3500) is amended by striking “$44,657,000” and inserting “$49,686,000”.

fable.w: This section only amends dollar amounts in a military construction authorization table for a National Security Agency project and makes a conforming amendment. There is no tempting reading here: no outside party is consulted, no hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue is created. It is purely a funding authorization change internal to the federal government.
fable.s: by striking “$86,354,000” in the amount column and inserting “$91,383,000”

qwen_block.w: This section is a technical amendment to an appropriations bill, specifically modifying the authorized funding amounts for a National Security Agency project. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or decision-making process involving parties outside the federal government. The actors involved are Congress (amending the statute) and the NSA (the recipient of funds), both of which are inside the federal government.
qwen_block.s: The table relating to the National Security Agency in section 2401(b) of the Military Construction Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2006 ... is amended in the item relating to Menwith Hill, United Kingdom, by striking “$86,354,000” in the amount column and inserting “$91,383,000”.

opus.w: The section only amends dollar figures for a National Security Agency construction project at Menwith Hill and makes the matching change elsewhere in the Act. No outside party is consulted, no rulemaking or public process is required, and no one is given a right to object or sue. Naming an agency project does not create any participation.
